question:
Re-check these netdisk-pan records against their first-party pages: confirm what still holds, set the fields that changed, and record a dead host as dead with the evidence. Use one `confirm` per evidence row and name only the fields that row's quote proves; list every field you did not re-read in `unread`. Set a field only when the new page states a different value.
An audit of the first attempt judged these claims unsupported by their sources; settle each one first:
- netdisk-pan/netdisk-fast-download $.free_tier.stated: Capture shows the site is live at 0.4.8 but says nothing about no charge or no key. The README capture says 123pan downloads usually need a login and the public site cannot log in, so "for the drivers it lists" is too broad.
- netdisk-pan/guangyapan $.identity_cost.detail: Docs show a phone-number SMS login but not the POST /v1/auth/verification 400 text, the email-path 404s, or the conclusion that no email-only path exists. Those parts are not in the capture.
- netdisk-pan/disroot-cloud $.reliability_note: Status disabled-Files part is supported. The 2026-11-02 update is not in the capture (latest entry 29.10.2026; a fresh read returned the identical sha256). Donation-funded, hand-reviewed extra storage and annual invoice claims are also absent from it. Unrecoverable-data wording is not there either.
- netdisk-pan/guangyapan $.free_tier.stated: 2T at registration and 500T for members are supported. "100 GB per file free and 1 TB for members" is not in the capture; a fresh read via jina returned the same page without it.
- netdisk-pan/shadow-drive $.identity_cost.detail: The 12 countries list is supported. A card requirement is not stated anywhere in the capture; the free 20 GB plan is not shown to need one, and no billing-address rule is stated.
- netdisk-pan/disroot-cloud $.reliability_note: The evidence is a Nextcloud status.php version string. It says nothing about donation funding, extra storage, VAT, or the Files outage. The value is a reliability note, not a version.
- netdisk-pan/guangyapan $.identity_cost.kind: The login box offers SMS verification. Nothing says any phone number works or which regions are accepted; the OpenList docs example is +86. "any-phone" is not shown.
- netdisk-pan/disroot-cloud $.free_tier.stated: Free amounts (1GB, 2GB, 500MB) and 21% VAT are supported, but the annual price steps (5 GB EUR 11 ... 60 GB EUR 110) are not in the capture; a fresh read returned the identical sha256 without them.
- netdisk-pan/netdisk-fast-download $.free_tier.stated: A 200 from the probe shows only that the host answers. It does not say parsing is free or keyless; the README says public parsing cannot log in to 123pan.
- netdisk-pan/disroot-cloud $.free_tier.stated: The page supports a free 2GB only. The price steps and the 21% VAT are not on this page. Value is mostly unsupported by this capture.
- netdisk-pan/ploud-storage $.free_tier.stated: Page says a dedicated space of 500 Go or 1 To. It does not say 1 TB for every account, that it is free, that no paid tiers exist, or that 1 TB is a definitive ceiling.
- netdisk-pan/netdisk-fast-download $.limits: Driver table supports 123云盘 100G with login above 100M and 蓝奏云 100M ("MiB" is the claim's reading of "M"). The word "now" (a change) is not shown, and "no published limit on lz.qaiu.top" is an absence claim that the table capture cannot show. A claim is the field's whole value, and the auditor must find one span in your capture that says it. For every field named in a confirm's paths, the value must be exactly what that one quote proves. When a field's value is a synthesis of several facts, do one of these: capture a page that states all of it and quote that; or narrow the field's value to the fact your quote proves and move each other fact to its own field or limits row with its own evidence; or leave the field out of every confirm and list it in unread. Never name a field whose value goes beyond its quote.
An audit of the first attempt judged these claims unsupported by their sources; settle each one first:
- netdisk-pan/disroot-cloud $.egress.terms: Capture holds only the free-storage and VAT lines. No fair-use, donation-funded or no-cap statement about egress appears.
- netdisk-pan/netdisk-fast-download $.identity_cost.kind: Probe record shows status 500 only. It does not state the request was keyless or that the identity cost is anonymous; no body is recorded.
- netdisk-pan/guangyapan $.identity_cost.detail: Quote is about real-name verification on the user agreement. It says nothing about the OpenList driver, phone number or SMS code in the value.
- netdisk-pan/trekmail-drive $.interface: Quote only proves the WebDAV server URL. REST appears in a separate line and rclone is a client tool, not a published interface; no single span lists the three.
- netdisk-pan/trekmail-drive $.egress.terms: Quote proves the 250 GB to 100 TB pricing sentence only. The absence of an egress line item is not provable from a span.
- netdisk-pan/asus-webstorage $.free_tier.stated: Quote is the storage row only. It does not show Lifetime Free pricing or that Lite/Pro/Enterprise are the paid plans.
- netdisk-pan/shadow-drive $.retention.stated: Quote says 20 GB free for life. It does not state Until deleted or that no retention clock is published.
- netdisk-pan/netdisk-fast-download $.identity_cost.detail: Probe record shows HTTP 401 on a HEAD request. It does not show the X-API-Key header or token parameter, nor that the free endpoint needs no key.
- netdisk-pan/disroot-cloud $.reliability_note: Quote proves only the unreadable sector sentence. The Nextcloud Files disabled while calendars, contacts and chat work is in a different part of the page and not in this span.
- netdisk-pan/asus-webstorage $.free_tier.stated: Quote proves only the Lifetime Free price row. The 5 GB, Free Trial label and paid tiers are not in the span.
- netdisk-pan/asus-webstorage $.chaining: Quote proves only that the maintainer closed the PR. Date 2026-02-26 is in a separate heading, the maintenance request in an earlier comment, so no one span covers the value.
- netdisk-pan/trekmail-drive $.retention.stated: Quote proves the 1 TB 30-day one-time trial. Permanent on the free plan is not stated in it.
- netdisk-pan/disroot-cloud $.reliability_note: Quote proves only Files disabled while calendars etc. work. The 29.10.2026 unreadable sector update is not in the span.
- netdisk-pan/asus-webstorage $.reliability_note: Quote proves only that the PR was closed. Date, API not public and Do not plan on it are not in the span.
- netdisk-pan/shadow-drive $.free_tier.stated: Cited capture (shadow.tech/eu/drive/) only says 20 GB free for life. The Basic and Premium prices and tier lines are not in it.
- netdisk-pan/disroot-cloud $.reliability_note: Quote proves only the unreadable sector sentence. The Nextcloud Files disabled part is not in the span.
